title: Claude Code Installed Plugins Registry (compat)
description: `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json` — a Claude-Code-owned, Claude-Code-written compat file that grok-build only READS, never writes. Deserialized into `ClaudeInstalledPlugins { plugins: HashMap<String, Vec<ClaudeInstalledEntry>> }` by `read_claude_installed_plugins`. Grok-build models only the narrow subset of fields it actually consumes (installPath/scope/projectPath); the real Claude Code writer's schema is richer (it carries additional presentation/version metadata not read here), so this schema deliberately never sets `additionalProperties: false` at any level. Parse failure of a SINGLE array entry (e.g. a missing installPath) fails `serde_json::from_str` for the WHOLE document, and the reader soft-fails to an empty result set (logged via `tracing::warn!`) rather than erroring — in practice the real Claude Code writer always populates installPath, so this schema still marks it required.

version.description: Known extra container-level key observed in real Claude-Code-written files (e.g. `"version": 2`). NOT modeled by `ClaudeInstalledPlugins` (no such field on the struct) — silently ignored by grok-build's reader since no `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` is present. Documented here as a known/tolerated extra key, not enforced.

plugins.description: Installed plugin entries keyed by `"<plugin-name>@<marketplace>"` or a bare `"<plugin-name>"` (no marketplace) — split via `key.splitn(2, '@')`: the part before `@` is the name, the part after (if any) is the marketplace. `#[serde(default)] HashMap<String, Vec<ClaudeInstalledEntry>>`.

additionalProperties.description: One or more install records for this plugin key (e.g. installed at multiple scopes/versions).

installedEntry.description: A single install entry within installed_plugins.json. `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] struct ClaudeInstalledEntry`.

installPath.description: Filesystem path the plugin was installed to. `install_path: PathBuf` — the ONLY entry field without `#[serde(default)]`; a missing `installPath` fails deserialization of this array element, which in turn fails the entire document (soft-fails to an empty result, see top-level description).

scope.description: Free-form install scope string. Only `"local"` and `"project"` are special-cased by `claude_install_visible` (project-gated visibility); any other value (including `"user"`, unrecognized values, or absent) is always-visible unless `projectPath` is also set non-empty. `scope: Option<String>`.

projectPath.description: Path this install is tied to. When non-empty together with `scope` `local`/`project` (or even alone — a non-empty `projectPath` gates visibility regardless of `scope`), the entry is only visible when `cwd` canonicalizes under this path. `project_path: Option<PathBuf>`.

version.description: Known extra entry-level key observed in real Claude-Code-written files (e.g. `"version": "1.0.0"`), distinct in type from the container-level integer `version`. NOT modeled by `ClaudeInstalledEntry` — silently ignored (no `deny_unknown_fields`). Documented here as a known/tolerated extra key, not enforced.
